item.title: 1: Tasks
item.text:
Complete these tasks on the Desktop (username: cisco, password: cisco) to collect the list of devices managed by the SD WAN Manager:

  1. Use either Bruno or Swagger as an API client on the desktop console - you can use Bruno by clicking the dog icon on the left menu bar OR use Swagger in Chrome by entering this address (http://192.168.10.1:8000/docs) or using the browser shortcut.
  2. Establish a session with the SD WAN Manager API using the credentials listed below to get a valid token.
  3. Query the SD WAN Manager API using the preconfigured request to pull the list of devices.
  4. Ensure that the SD WAN Manager API returned a list of devices similar to the sample response shown below (so that logs can be found later when grading the task).

Do not modify anything on the desktop except what is needed to perform the tasks because it will affect the grading process.


API Credentials

Parameter Value
j_username user1
j_password password1

​
